subject: Complex numbers
title: Why Complex Numbers Are Needed
subtitle: Where the real numbers get stuck, why cubic equations forced the issue, and why the extension stops at the complex numbers.
prerequisite_note: Chapter 0 and solving quadratics. University and PhD tiers also use polynomial division and fields, explained where used.
objectives: Explain how number systems grow from N to R and what a consistent extension must preserve.
Prove x^2 + 1 = 0 has no real solution and decide when real quadratics have real roots.
Derive and use Cardano's formula, including the product condition on cube roots.
Prove that a depressed cubic has three distinct real roots exactly when 4p^3 + 27q^2 < 0, and state the casus irreducibilis theorem.
Explain why polynomial equations need nothing beyond C, and what going further costs (Frobenius).
Prove that three mutually unbiased qubit bases require complex amplitudes.
